lines.zh: 我一步一步往你那边走，不拐弯。
lines.en: Step by step I come toward you, and I do not turn.

lines.zh: 九十颗心在身子里，沉得每一步都慢。
lines.en: Ninety hearts sit in this body, weighting every step.

lines.zh: 蠕变的地面软，我的脚印留得很深。
lines.en: Creeponia's ground is soft, and my prints sink deep.

lines.zh: 我不用跑，走过去就够久了。
lines.en: I need not run; walking over already takes long enough.

lines.zh: 我绕石头，不绕开你。
lines.en: I go around rocks, never around you.

lines.zh: 这片地是我的路，我走了很多遍。
lines.en: This ground is my road, and I have walked it often.

lines.zh: 腿拖着走，可方向一直没变。
lines.en: My legs drag, but the direction never changes.

lines.zh: 你听见那种闷响了吗，是我的脚。
lines.en: You hear that muffled thud? That is my foot.

lines.zh: 我不急，急的人通常先死。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the hurried ones die first.

lines.zh: 前面有谁站着，我就往那边挪。
lines.en: Whoever stands ahead, I shuffle toward them.

lines.zh: 每走近一步，我就更确定是你。
lines.en: Each step closer makes me more certain it is you.

lines.zh: 蠕变的天是灰绿的，我踩着它走。
lines.en: Creeponia's sky is grey-green, and I walk beneath it.

lines.zh: 站着的时候，我能听见身体里在响。
lines.en: Standing here, I can hear things shifting inside.

lines.zh: 九十颗心不该这么安静。
lines.en: Ninety hearts should not be this quiet.

lines.zh: 这张嘴张开时，是蠕变的味道。
lines.en: When this mouth opens, it tastes of Creeponia.

lines.zh: 这具身子装过很多东西，现在空着。
lines.en: This body has held many things; now it is empty.

lines.zh: 我在等有谁走近，等得不费力。
lines.en: I wait for someone to come close, and waiting costs me nothing.

lines.zh: 风里有股腥味，不全是我的。
lines.en: There is blood on the wind, and not all of it mine.

lines.zh: 我不睡觉，只是把眼睛闭上。
lines.en: I do not sleep; I only close my eyes.

lines.zh: 有东西在我皮下挪，我不去管它。
lines.en: Something shifts beneath my skin, and I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我把手垂着，垂到膝盖以下。
lines.en: I let my hands hang below my knees.

lines.zh: 这片空地我记得，上次也是我在这。
lines.en: I remember this clearing; last time I stood here too.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，就不打算再看别处。
lines.en: I have seen you, and I intend to look nowhere else.

lines.zh: 你的心跳我数得清，比我快得多。
lines.en: I can count your heartbeat, and it runs far faster.

lines.zh: 你站那儿别动，我要好好看看。
lines.en: Stand still there; I want a proper look.

lines.zh: 我这双眼看人只分两种：近和远。
lines.en: My eyes sort people into two kinds: near and far.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁的味道，还有怕。
lines.en: You smell of iron, and also of fear.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，这个角度你能看清我。
lines.en: I tilt my head so you can see me clearly.

lines.zh: 别假装没看见，我已经在走了。
lines.en: Do not pretend you missed me; I am already walking.

lines.zh: 你影子在地上抖，我知道为什么。
lines.en: Your shadow trembles on the ground, and I know why.

lines.zh: 我看着你，像看一顿迟早的事。
lines.en: I look at you like a meal that is only a matter of time.

lines.zh: 你眼睛很好，可惜用不上了。
lines.en: Your eyes are good, and soon they will be useless.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里出了点声音，像漏气。
lines.en: Something escapes my throat, like air from a leak.

lines.zh: 疼让我停了半步，就半步。
lines.en: Pain stops me for half a step, and only that.

lines.zh: 你敢打我，那我就认准你了。
lines.en: You dared to hit me, so now I am fixed on you.

lines.zh: 我这身子里，疼传得很慢。
lines.en: Inside this body, pain travels slowly.

lines.zh: 血从口子流出来，我不去捂。
lines.en: Blood runs from the wound, and I do not cover it.

lines.zh: 这一下比我想的深。
lines.en: That went deeper than I expected.

lines.zh: 我低头看伤口，看得太久了。
lines.en: I look down at the wound for too long.

lines.zh: 我不跑，跑会让我更疼。
lines.en: I will not run; running would hurt more.

lines.zh: 你打疼了一个装东西的壳。
lines.en: You have hurt a shell built for holding things.

lines.zh: 再加把劲，我还没倒。
lines.en: Try harder; I have not fallen.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，引不动我。
lines.en: That little thing in your hand will not move me.

lines.zh: 我不吃草，也不吃你举着的果子。
lines.en: I eat no grass, and no fruit you raise either.

lines.zh: 有人试过用肉引我，那人没回来。
lines.en: Someone tried meat as bait; that someone did not return.

lines.zh: 你晃吧，我的方向从来是直的。
lines.en: Wave it all you like; my path has always been straight.

lines.zh: 诱饵留给会拐弯的东西。
lines.en: Bait is for creatures that can be turned.

lines.zh: 我只要一样：你站在那里。
lines.en: I want only one thing: you, standing there.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我也不会去闻。
lines.en: Set it down if you wish; I will not sniff it.

lines.zh: 我饿，但我不挑食，也不追食。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I am not picky and do not chase food.

lines.zh: 你的手抖了，那东西就掉了价。
lines.en: Your hand shakes, and the offer loses value.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，我用不着。
lines.en: Put it away; I have no use for it.

lines.zh: 你撞我身上，像撞进一堵湿墙。
lines.en: You hit me like walking into a wet wall.

lines.zh: 我没让，是你自己退的。
lines.en: I did not yield; you stepped back on your own.

lines.zh: 我的皮比你想象的要紧。
lines.en: My hide is tighter than you imagined.

lines.zh: 别贴着我走，我转身很慢。
lines.en: Do not walk against me; I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 你被我挤到一边，这算轻的。
lines.en: I crowded you aside, and that counts as gentle.

lines.zh: 骨头撞骨头，你听见那声了吗。
lines.en: Bone met bone; did you hear that sound?

lines.zh: 我擦过去，你就该明白差多少。
lines.en: I brushed past, and you should understand the difference now.

lines.zh: 我不推人，我只是不停。
lines.en: I do not push people; I simply do not stop.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚背，我低头看了看。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot, and I looked down.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我就不只是走了。
lines.en: Bump me once more and I will do more than walk.

lines.zh: 成双这种事，轮不到我这副身子。
lines.en: Pairing off is not for a body like mine.

lines.zh: 我没有伴，只有装得下的东西。
lines.en: I have no mate, only things I can hold.

lines.zh: 我这壳里住着的，不是我一个。
lines.en: What lives in this shell is not only me.

lines.zh: 别的生物会成对，我只想再满一点。
lines.en: Others pair up; I only want to be fuller.

lines.zh: 你看见我身边是空的，那很正常。
lines.en: You see no one beside me, and that is normal.

lines.zh: 我不找同类，同类也不找我。
lines.en: I seek no kin, and no kin seeks me.

lines.zh: 繁殖是活物的事，我不算。
lines.en: Breeding belongs to the living, and I do not count.

lines.zh: 我一个人走完这片蠕变，够久了。
lines.en: I have walked this Creeponia alone long enough.

lines.zh: 有谁想住进来，我一向不拒绝。
lines.en: Anyone wanting to move in is never refused.

lines.zh: 这两个字跟我没缘分。
lines.en: Those two words and I were never meant.

lines.zh: 地上有块东西，我捡起来看了看。
lines.en: Something lies on the ground; I pick it up and look.

lines.zh: 我把它攥在手里，攥得它变形。
lines.en: I close my hand on it until it changes shape.

lines.zh: 我不掉东西，可我捡东西。
lines.en: I leave nothing behind, but I do pick things up.

lines.zh: 这块肉还热，我直接吞了。
lines.en: This meat is still warm, so I swallow it whole.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很慢，捡完要歇一会。
lines.en: I bend slowly and rest after picking it up.

lines.zh: 你掉的剑在泥里，我踢开了。
lines.en: Your dropped sword is in the mud; I kick it aside.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进嘴里，连土一起。
lines.en: I push it into my mouth, soil and all.

lines.zh: 手里这点重量，我几乎没感觉。
lines.en: This weight in my hand barely registers.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块石头，又扔回原处。
lines.en: I pick up a stone and toss it back.

lines.zh: 这具身子收东西，比丢东西容易。
lines.en: This body takes things in more easily than it gives.

lines.zh: 你进了这片地，我就定了方向。
lines.en: You entered this ground, so my direction is set.

lines.zh: 我转头的时候，脖子发出一声脆响。
lines.en: When I turn my head, my neck cracks sharply.

lines.zh: 目标不用挑，走近的就算。
lines.en: No need to choose a target; whoever approaches will do.

lines.zh: 我鼻子抽了一下，锁住你的味。
lines.en: One sniff, and your scent is locked in.

lines.zh: 你现在开始跑也来得及，只是没用。
lines.en: You may start running now; it simply will not help.

lines.zh: 我把脚从泥里拔出来，朝你迈第一步。
lines.en: I pull my foot from the mud and take the first step.

lines.zh: 九十颗心的东西认定你，你该慌。
lines.en: Ninety hearts have chosen you; be afraid.

lines.zh: 我看见了，就别想让我忘。
lines.en: I have seen you, and I do not forget.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，我的才刚开始。
lines.en: Your breathing is ragged; mine has only begun.

lines.zh: 我抬高下巴，把你放进视线正中。
lines.en: I raise my chin and set you in the center of sight.

lines.zh: 这声音是我在叫你，不是叫别人。
lines.en: This sound is me calling you, and no one else.

lines.zh: 我动之前，先让你看见我动。
lines.en: Before I move, I let you see me move.

lines.zh: 你躲到树后，树挡不住这个。
lines.en: Hide behind a tree; a tree will not stop this.

lines.zh: 我选了你，你今天就是我的事。
lines.en: I chose you, so today you are my business.

lines.zh: 你带着腐肉味，我认得出主人。
lines.en: You smell of rotten flesh. I know a keeper.

lines.zh: 这群里就你走得最慢。
lines.en: Of this group, you walk slowest.

lines.zh: 我一直看着，连眨眼都省了。
lines.en: I keep watching, and I have stopped blinking.

lines.zh: 你往左，我的头就往左。
lines.en: You go left and my head goes left.

lines.zh: 蠕变的维度里，我慢慢挪。
lines.en: In the Creeponia dimension I shuffle along.

lines.zh: 蠕变维度的肉壁，正随我呼吸起伏。
lines.en: The flesh walls of Creeponia swell with my breath.

lines.zh: 距离在缩短，你算得出来。
lines.en: The distance is closing, and you can do the math.

lines.zh: 我把手抬起来，又慢慢放下。
lines.en: I raise a hand, then lower it slowly.

lines.zh: 你退三步，我进两步，账很好算。
lines.en: You retreat three, I advance two; the sum is simple.

lines.zh: 这具身体不需要喘，只需要走。
lines.en: This body does not need breath, only walking.

lines.zh: 你别回头，回头会看见我还在。
lines.en: Do not look back; you will see I am still there.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脖子，那里最省事。
lines.en: I watch your neck; that is the easiest place.

lines.zh: 你踩进水洼，声音替我说了话。
lines.en: You step in a puddle, and the sound speaks for me.

lines.zh: 我们之间只剩这些草。
lines.en: All that remains between us is this grass.

lines.zh: 我还没动手，是因为路还没走完。
lines.en: I have not struck because the walk is not finished.

lines.zh: 你很会跑，我很会等。
lines.en: You are good at running; I am good at waiting.

lines.zh: 我迈一步，地面跟着震一下。
lines.en: One step of mine shakes the ground.

lines.zh: 你绕到石柱后，柱子挡不住。
lines.en: Hide behind the pillar. It is not enough.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛没有眼白，只能看。
lines.en: My eyes have no whites. Only looking.

lines.zh: 你的箭射在我胸口，我不停。
lines.en: Your arrow in my chest. I do not stop.

lines.zh: 我把路让开一半，留一半给你。
lines.en: I give up half the path. Keep your half.

lines.zh: 你抬手了，我先等你落空。
lines.en: You raise your arm. I wait for it to miss.

lines.zh: 我的手落下来，你听见骨头的声音。
lines.en: My hand falls, and you hear your bones.

lines.zh: 这一拳把你打进了灌木里。
lines.en: This blow puts you into the bushes.

lines.zh: 你飞出去的时候，我还在往前走。
lines.en: While you fly, I am still walking forward.

lines.zh: 我不收力，收了就没意思了。
lines.en: I do not hold back; holding back is pointless.

lines.zh: 你摔在地上，我才刚热身。
lines.en: You hit the ground, and I have only warmed up.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的领口，把你提起来。
lines.en: I take your collar and lift you off the ground.

lines.zh: 这一下砸在肩上，你半边身子软了。
lines.en: That lands on your shoulder, and half of you goes slack.

lines.zh: 你的血溅到我手上，我不擦。
lines.en: Your blood spatters my hand, and I do not wipe it.

lines.zh: 我抬手的时候没有预兆，这就是预兆。
lines.en: My arm gives no warning, and that is the warning.

lines.zh: 你退得够快，只断了两根。
lines.en: You were quick enough to only break two.

lines.zh: 我又补了一下，怕你还能站。
lines.en: I add another blow, in case you can still stand.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在我手上像纸。
lines.en: Your armor behaves like paper in my hands.

lines.zh: 我打完站着看你，等你还动不动。
lines.en: I stand and watch, waiting to see if you move.

lines.zh: 你倒下之后，这里就安静了。
lines.en: After you fall, this place becomes quiet.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的脚踝，往泥里拖。
lines.en: I take your ankle and drag you into the mud.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你贴着树滑下去。
lines.en: This shove slides you down the tree.

lines.zh: 我用肘压你的喉咙，很沉。
lines.en: My elbow on your throat. Heavy.

lines.zh: 你的盾牌凹了一块，还举着。
lines.en: Your shield dented and still up.

lines.zh: 我把你按进地里，泥没过膝。
lines.en: I press you down. Mud to the knee.

lines.zh: 你咳了一声，我听到了。
lines.en: You coughed once. I heard it.

lines.zh: 蠕变的土翻开，我从底下站起来。
lines.en: Creeponia's soil breaks open, and I rise out of it.

lines.zh: 我一出现，附近的草木就静了。
lines.en: The moment I appear, nearby plants go silent.

lines.zh: 这片灰绿的地多了一个影子。
lines.en: A new shadow joins this grey-green ground.

lines.zh: 生成在这里，我就从这儿开始走。
lines.en: Spawned here, I begin walking from here.

lines.zh: 我站起来时，土块从背上滚下去。
lines.en: As I rise, clods of earth roll off my back.

lines.zh: 天没亮，我已经在这片地上。
lines.en: The sky is not light yet, and I am already here.

lines.zh: 没人迎接我，这地方不需要仪式。
lines.en: No one greets me, and this place needs no ceremony.

lines.zh: 我的重量让脚下的地凹了一块。
lines.en: My weight presses a hollow into the ground.

lines.zh: 第一口气我吸得很深，土腥味的。
lines.en: My first breath is deep and tastes of soil.

lines.zh: 我睁眼先找方向，再找人。
lines.en: I open my eyes, find the way, then find people.

lines.zh: 这维度多了一具空壳，就是这样。
lines.en: One more empty shell in this dimension, that is all.

lines.zh: 我从空旷处来，往有人处去。
lines.en: I come from the empty places and go where people are.

lines.zh: 火在我身上烧得慢，皮太厚了。
lines.en: Fire burns slowly on me; my hide is too thick.

lines.zh: 落地那下，我腿里的东西全错位了。
lines.en: On landing, everything inside my legs shifted wrong.

lines.zh: 水灌进这副空壳，我沉得很干脆。
lines.en: Water pours into this empty shell, and I sink cleanly.

lines.zh: 炸得我半边身子不见了，还站着。
lines.en: The blast took half of me, and I am still standing.

lines.zh: 那支箭插着我，像一根刺。
lines.en: That arrow sits in me like a splinter.

lines.zh: 这股力钻进皮下，和我争地方。
lines.en: This force burrows under my skin and argues for space.

lines.zh: 我饿得壳都瘪了，还是得走。
lines.en: Hunger hollows the shell, and I still must walk.

lines.zh: 雷下来，我全身的骨头都亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning falls, and every bone in me flashes.

lines.zh: 掉进这里，连壳都没了。
lines.en: Falling in here, even the shell is gone.
